summary.en: The phosphor arc: a prompt types the problem and collapses into a point of light, the claim under the horizon, chapters of the tool at work, you at both ends, the install under a break, the tunnel into the tagline, the lock-up out of a cursor.
summary.zh: phosphor 的骨架：提示符敲出问题并收成一个光点，地平线下的主张，工具工作的几个章节，两头是你，在停顿里安装，冲过隧道进入标语，从光标里出来的收尾。

fits: CLI, agent, CI and infrastructure launches of 30–75 s.
notFor: Products without a command line; films under 25 s (use boot → end, a 10 s sting).

intent.en: One terminal session from the failing command to the URL, the cursor opening and closing it.
intent.zh: 一次终端会话，从失败的命令到网址，光标开场也收尾。

content.en: A failing command, a two-line claim, 1–4 chapters of the tool at work, install commands and steps, a two-line tagline, name, chips and URL.
content.zh: 一条失败的命令、两行主张、1–4 章工具工作、安装命令和步骤、两行标语、产品名、标签和网址。

fits.zh: 30–75 秒的命令行、智能体、CI 与基础设施发布片。

notFor.zh: 没有命令行的产品；25 秒以下（用 boot → end 的 10 秒短片）。

en: Chinese pages read longer: the 43 s reseed demo runs about 55 s in Chinese.
zh: 中文页读得更久：43 秒的 reseed 示例中文约 55 秒。

source.path: assets/templates/phosphor/content.js; the phosphor demo film; references/modes/phosphor.md (use cases)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead against the original template's scene order and lengths (card, Differs from upstream)
